Apple rolls out new iPhone wallpapers every year, and you can download the newly-added designs for iOS 27 here. However, iOS 27 also adds the ability to customise wallpapers, and we’ll show you how.

Here’s how to customise wallpapers in iOS 27

As part of the overall AI overhaul in iOS 27 this year, Apple has completely revamped its Image Playground app.

Image Playground now offers more powerful image generation capabilities with far fewer restrictions. It can also help you create wallpaper images in just the right size.

But you don’t even need to open the Image Playground app to create wallpapers.

iOS 27 lets you create iPhone wallpapers directly within the wallpaper picker.

Go to "Settings" → "Wallpaper" → "Add New Wallpaper", or long-press the Lock Screen and tap the "+" button to open the iOS 27 wallpaper gallery.

A new Image Playground option has been added to the top row of the gallery this year. iOS 27 will also automatically add some AI-generated images to the "Featured Wallpaper" category.

For example, you’ll see suggested wallpapers based on photos from your albums, reinterpreted in new styles.

During my time trying out iOS 27, my iPhone automatically turned a few of my favourite photos into stunning stylised wallpapers without me lifting a finger — the results were truly outstanding.

Wherever you see AI-generated wallpapers in the gallery, a new Image Playground icon will appear next to them so you know exactly where the image came from.

If you like an AI wallpaper Apple has suggested, just select it and use it.

But iOS 27 also lets you tap the Image Playground button in the top row to create a completely custom wallpaper. Image Playground will ask you to describe the image you want — you can choose a style or use an existing photo or person as a basis.

The generated image will automatically be adjusted to the ideal size for an iPhone wallpaper.

Have you tried the new wallpaper creation tools in iOS 27? Share your thoughts in the comments.
